data.narrative:
Deep Atomic is a pre-seed stage nuclear energy company founded by William G.J. Theron. The nuclear energy sector includes a comp universe of 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 5 private peers (Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, Zephyr Fusion), though traditional peer-median methodologies are not applicable here.

The peer-median approach cannot be reliably deployed due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage datapoints. While 4 same-sector peers exist in nuclear energy, filtering by stage and valuation tier yields fewer than the 3 minimum datapoints required for statistical validity. A cross-sector median would introduce noise and obscure Deep Atomic's sector-specific dynamics, making it an unreliable anchor.

Without sufficient comparable transactions or valuations at pre-seed in nuclear energy, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range grounded in triangulated methodology. Key uncertainties include the absence of disclosed funding history for Deep Atomic, lack of pre-seed comparable valuations within the nuclear sector, and the wide heterogeneity in business models and technology maturity across the available comp set. Future valuation work should prioritize gathering pre-seed and seed stage funding data from the private nuclear peer set, or consider expanding methodologies to revenue multiples or cost-of-capital approaches if financial data becomes available.
